name: Post Punk Strikes Back Again - Passe Geral 3 dias - 27,28,29 novembro
description: The Post Punk Strikes Back Again (PPSBA) festival returns for its seventh edition, moving to the historic Auditório CCOP in Porto. The event takes place over three days, from November 27 to 29, 2026, featuring Post-Punk and Coldwave music.
longDescription:
The Post Punk Strikes Back Again (PPSBA) festival is back for its seventh edition, bringing significant changes to the audience experience. The event is scheduled for November 27, 28, and 29, 2026, at a new, more intimate venue.

Moving from Hard Club, the festival will now be held at the historic Auditório CCOP in the city centre. This change aims to provide a superior aesthetic and acoustic environment, ideal for the dark and immersive sounds of Post-Punk and Coldwave. The full lineup will be announced progressively in the coming weeks.

General passes for the three days are available for 63€. Tickets can be purchased online via the BOL platform and associated points of sale like Fnac and Worten, or at the Transistor shop located in the CCOP building in Porto. The event is suitable for ages 6 and up.

longDescriptionPt:

Esta mudança pretende oferecer um ambiente estético e acústico superior, ideal para os sons sombrios e imersivos do Post-Punk e Coldwave. O cartaz completo será anunciado progressivamente nas próximas semanas.

Os passes gerais para os três dias estão disponíveis por 63€. Os bilhetes podem ser comprados online através da plataforma BOL e pontos de venda associados, como Fnac e Worten, ou na loja Transistor, localizada no edifício CCOP, no Porto. O evento é adequado para maiores de 6 anos.
